purposes.normal_strength: Reduce inherited shallow surface relief on compact forge parts without changing source maps.
purposes.stone_tint: Warm weathered masonry tint over the unchanged D5 stone surface.
purposes.iron_tint: Dark, warm worked iron over the unchanged D6 surface; no new metal ingredient.
purposes.soot_tint: Darken chamber lining and mortar backing without lighting painted into albedo.
purposes.manual_amount: Brief intensity while the original successful craft response exists; no new timer.
purposes.firing_amount: Intensity of a real reserved feeder firing, driven by its native progress.
purposes.held_amount: Quieter held paid heat while explicit pause, obstruction, trial or distance prevents work.
purposes.clinker_gain: Bounded emissive response on the cold clinker surface, never a fuel inventory.
purposes.scar_gain: Buried light remains visible without bloom; adds no point light or gameplay heat.
purposes.scar_wave_per_m: Spatial variation along the actual fracture; phase uses native progress, never TIME.
